stem_book: A block is sliding down an inclined plane of slope θ with constant velocity, and at an instant t = 0 this block is given an upward momentum so that it starts moving up on the inclined surface with velocity u. The distance (S) travelled by the block before its velocity becomes zero is ____ (g = gravitational acceleration) (a) u²/(4g sinθ) (b) 2u²/(g cosθ) (c) u²/(√2 g cosθ) (d) u²/(2g cosθ)
reason: Print omits 'with constant velocity' (needed: no μ given) — added to stem. Key d u²/(2g cosθ) vs working: sliding at constant v → μ = tanθ, retardation up = 2g sinθ → S = u²/(4g sinθ) = (a); no friction assumption gives (d) for θ from horizontal.
work: μ = tanθ ; a_up = g sinθ + μg cosθ = 2g sinθ ; S = u²/(2·2g sinθ) = u²/(4g sinθ)
